item.title: Iran-Pakistan chamber seeks free trade deal amid tariff hike
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The head of the Iran-Pakistan Joint Chamber says the chamber is negotiating to remove trade barriers following Pakistan’s recent increase in tariffs on some Iranian exports.

item.title: Iran dismisses US account of attacks on Iranian oil tankers, says it’s acting in self-defense
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has dismissed the US narrative about its attacks on Iranian oil tankers in the Persian Gulf, saying Iran is acting in self-defense in the face of a maritime blockade and economic war imposed by Washington.

item.title: Iran dismantles terrorist cells in southeast, arrests nine
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Ministry of Intelligence has announced that three operational cells belonging to a Takfiri terrorist group had been disbanded in the country’s southeast, with nine terrorists arrested and three others killed during clashes with security forces.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86257439/Iran-dismantles-terrorist-cells-in-southeast-arrests-nine

item.title: Baqaei: Iran’s actions in Strait of Hormuz purely defensive

item.title: Iran unveils new domestically-developed antivirus software
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Simultaneously with ELECOMP 2026, the country's largest exhibition for electronics, computer technologies, and e-commerce, Iran unveiled its second homegrown antivirus software, dubbed Ayyza, using artificial intelligence and machine learning to detect an unknown malware and unidentified cyber threats.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86257215/Iran-unveils-new-domestically-developed-antivirus-software

Tehran, IRNA – Simultaneously with ELECOMP 2026, the country's largest exhibition for electronics, computer technologies, and e-commerce, Iran unveiled its second homegrown antivirus software, dubbed Ayyza, using artificial intelligence and machine learning to detect an unknown malware and unidentified cyber threats.

item.title: In photos: US attack turns wedding into wake in Iran
item.description: Images show the damage caused on September 1, 2026, by a US airstrike on a house in Hormozgan Province, where a group of people were attending a wedding ceremony. The attack left four people, including a child, dead and 68 others injured.
